svg.title: nightgem: a night-shift factory that turns rough stones into cut gems
svg.desc: At night, a foreman with a clipboard places rough grey stones on a conveyor belt. The belt fans out into three lanes where workers cut them into rubies, diamonds, emeralds, sapphires, amethysts and topaz. An inspector checks each gem with a loupe and the finished stones land in a display tray next to a checked report, while the sky brightens toward dawn on the right.

g.text: Spec at dusk. Gems at dawn.
